title: Asahi Linux 7.1 Progress Report
summary: Asahi Linux 7.1 Progress Report documents the ongoing development efforts to run Linux on Apple Silicon hardware, detailing recent driver improvements, kernel updates, and hardware compatibility additions for M-series chips.
problem_solved: Enables Linux operating system to run natively on Apple Silicon Macs, overcoming hardware and software barriers including GPU drivers and boot mechanisms.
why_valuable: Provides open-source operating system freedom for Apple hardware users and pushes forward ARM64 Linux driver development for cutting-edge silicon.
